final: WITH purpose_averages AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM "order" WHERE amount > 2802.0 GROUP BY k_symbol), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_amount FROM purpose_averages) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.avg_amount FROM purpose_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.avg_amount IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_amount > o.avg_amount
